files.content:
<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  Quick order in one click: compact rows (name, weight, summary, price) each with an order button named after
  the dish, under a phone field that the one click uses. Axes: phone (show, hide), tone.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Dish, FoodLabels } from "./dish-showcase.types";

  export type QuickOrderProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    lead?: string;
    dishes: Dish[];
    empty?: string;
    labels: FoodLabels;
    phone?: "show" | "hide";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Button from "../compose/Button.svelte";
  import Group from "../compose/Group.svelte";
  import Inline from "../compose/Inline.svelte";
  import Input from "../compose/Input.svelte";
  import List from "../compose/List.svelte";
  import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.svelte";
  import Stack from "../compose/Stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";
  import EmptyState from "../components/empty-state.svelte";
  import Field from "../components/field.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import { fmtMoney, tpl } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    lead = "",
    dishes,
    empty = "",
    labels,
    phone = "show",
    tone = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: QuickOrderProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame id={id} title={title} lead={lead} tone={tone} landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}>
  {#if ((dishes?.length ?? 0) === 0)}
    <EmptyState icon="zap" title={empty} />
  {:else}
    <Stack gap="4" align="stretch" class="mx-auto w-full max-w-3xl">
      {#if ((phone as string) === "show")}
        <Field label={labels.phone} htmlFor={tpl("{0}-phone", id)}>
          <Input type="tel" name={tpl("{0}-phone", id)} id={tpl("{0}-phone", id)} />
        </Field>
      {/if}
      <List tag="ul" class="flex flex-col" data-slot="items">
        {#each dishes as d (d.id)}
          <ListItem class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4 border-b border-border py-4" data-slot="item">
            <Stack gap="0" class="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <Group gap="2" align="baseline">
                <Text size="base" weight="semibold">
                  {d.name}
                </Text>
                <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
                  {d.weight}
                </Text>
              </Group>
              <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
                {d.summary}
              </Text>
            </Stack>
            <Inline class="text-base font-bold">
              {fmtMoney(d.price, d.currency)}
            </Inline>
            <Button variant="default" size="sm" type="button" aria-label={tpl(labels.orderOf, d.name)}>
              <LucideIcon name="zap" size={16} />
              {labels.order}
            </Button>
          </ListItem>
        {/each}
      </List>
    </Stack>
  {/if}
</SectionFrame>
